summary: SPACE RELICS is a virtual museum that provides the platform for telling stories of ten NASA machines abandoned on the Moon and Mars. The exhibits present their stories in first-person narratives accompanied by authentic photographs of NASA along with orbital images and generated voices of artificial intelligence. You will have the opportunity to visit the Lunar Sanctuary and the Martian Frontier, hear the stories of these machines and pass the knowledge test. The mission of SPACE RELICS is to preserve the heritage of these forgotten pioneers of space exploration.
details:
For the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge, we built SPACE RELICS.

SPACE RELICS is a museum that shows ten historic NASA machines left on the Moon and Mars.

The issue is that every mission beyond Earth leaves hardware behind. Rovers, landers and instruments that finished their work now lie still on two worlds. Their stories may be forgotten.

Our solution is a website. On this website, each machine is a museum exhibit that speaks in the first person.

Visitors can explore two wings: the Lunar Sanctuary with the Lunar Roving Vehicle, Apollo 11 Descent Stage, ALSEP, Surveyor 1 and Lunar Laser Retroreflector; and the Martian Frontier, with Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Phoenix and Ingenuity.

Each exhibit contains a story told in the first person, verified facts and coordinates, a real NASA surface photograph, an orbital view of its resting place, and an AI-narrated audio version of its story.

A five-question quiz invites visitors to test what they learned.

All facts, dates, coordinates and photographs come from NASA sources (see NASA Data). All images are NASA photographs; no artist's concepts are presented as photographs.

The website is a static site built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript and is hosted on GitHub Pages.

SPACE RELICS is made for people of all ages, especially children and students. SPACE RELICS turns space history into stories that you can hear, see and explore.
